items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: She used to sing Ma Rainey, Bessie Smith stuff, blues, blues ballads.

ctx.x: You know, see, you can treat you fair, but let you live, you know. You can make it. You just get a little something out of this, you know. Of course you have to get a little something out of this, I mean, you can live. And me, I got seven charons, at least I had seven, one time. And I got a bunch of grand charons, and you can see from our conditions, we all got to live together to make it. Yeah, yeah. We got around about four families right in here.

Yeah, we got, I live way uptown, lived up there on Drive Street, way uptown near Tulane. Yeah. We got, man, our places are getting crowded, you know. They got, how many people we got living together? We got, there are eight of us there now. Yeah, yeah, yeah. She used to sing in a band. Oh, she did? Yeah, she used to sing pretty good. She used to sing Ma Rainey, Bessie Smith stuff, blues, blues ballads. She could really, she could really sing.
Yeah, that's back in Beaver Alley Reader.
